newsitem.title: USA: Stocks edge up to record; await Greenspan speech.
newsitem.headline: Stocks edge up to record; await Greenspan speech.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks edged into record territory Monday on more upbeat earnings from high technology companies, but the market was nervous ahead of testimony Tuesday by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on the economy.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 10.77 points at 6,843.87, surpassing Friday's record of 6,833.10. In the broader market, advances and declines were about even on moderate volume of 443 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
